name: notes
summary: Many small ideas captured as tiles you can filter by tag; pinned tiles are the ones that should change a decision.

slots.name: scope
slots.says: what the notes cover, e.g. a week or a project

slots.name: headline
slots.says: H1: the most important thing the notes say

slots.name: lede
slots.says: one line: how many sources and what pinned means here

slots.name: notes
slots.says: notes as a JSON array; inside JSON, write </ as <\/: [{"tag":"one word","title":"the point as a finding","body":"1-2 lines","quote":"optional","who":"","date":"","pin":true}]; 3-6 distinct tags

finish_line.says: one H1, and it states the finding
links the tunnel kit, so it renders in every viewer
no stylesheet or script from another host (the kit is ours)
every tile title states a point, not a topic
pins only on what should change a decision
one accent, used only for what matters and meaning the same thing everywhere
works at 400px wide and in dark mode
